about: Every setting and word a page can put on the member block, each as data-members-<name> on the block's own element. The platform reads them when it builds the page. A value listed under values counts only when written exactly so, in lowercase.
mount: The block is an element carrying data-members, and it is a <section>: the platform builds the page again to keep the members fresh, and then finds only section elements carrying it. Everything written inside the block is replaced.
lists: country, region and city each take one place or a list. A list is separated by '|', never a comma, and a single value with a comma in it ends with '|': the platform splits a value on commas when it holds no '|' or ';', and many region names carry one. data-members-region="England: City of Manchester, Greater Manchester|"; data-members-city="Chelmsford|Colchester|Braintree". The platform reads every country, region and town combination, in the order written: the first fills the block and the rest top it up while it holds fewer than count, so the order is the priority. Vary one level only - one region with several towns, or several regions with none - because several of both pairs every town with every region. There is no step to the whole region once the towns run out. min counts the combined total.

strict.about: true keeps the block to this brand's own members. Anything else, "True" and "false" included, shows members of other brands.

types.about: Who is shown, comma-separated: "female", or "female,couple". The one control over gender; nothing filters on who members are seeking.

age-min.about: The youngest age shown, a whole number.

age-max.about: The oldest age shown, a whole number.

country.about: One country or a list, spelled exactly as lib/places holds it. A wrong spelling is ignored, not refused: the block fills from elsewhere and looks normal.

region.about: One region or a list, spelled exactly as lib/places holds it. Many region names carry a comma: end a single one with '|'.

city.about: One town or a list, spelled exactly as lib/places holds it.

count.about: How many members the block shows at most. Above 20 is cut to 20.

min.about: The fewest members worth showing; with fewer, empty-text shows instead. Never above count.

bio.about: off leaves member descriptions out of the page entirely.

cta.about: off removes the link on each card.

cta-href.about: Where each card's link goes: the brand's join address unless set.

join-tile.about: off removes the join card that closes the block.

image-size.about: The photo size requested, in pixels.

styles.about: none gives the platform's classed markup with no styling of its own. This pattern's stylesheet styles that markup, so keep it.

cta-text.about: The words on each card's link. It goes to the join flow, never to the member's own profile, so the brand's words should not promise one.

join-text.about: The words on the join card.

verified-text.about: The badge on members whose ID is verified. The badge itself cannot be turned off.

empty-text.about: Shown in place of the members when fewer than min match. A sentence that is true when the block is empty.

not-available: the order members are shown in
hiding a member's name, age or town
a link to a member's own profile
